title: Conceptual Network
definition: A graph-based representation of concepts and their relationships within a domain.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a network of thoughts where each thought is connected to related thoughts.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A conceptual network is a graph-based representation of concepts and their relationships.
difficulty_levels.expert: Conceptual networks are a fundamental aspect of knowledge representation and formal concept analysis.

extra_fields.insight: Conceptual networks allow us to explore complex relationships and make philosophical insights.
